name: loong
description: Evidence-first reasoning and risk-scaled task orchestration for Codex.

interface.longDescription: Applies first-principles decomposition, explicit fact and inference labels, adversarial review, and independent cross-review. Simple tasks stay concise; complex tasks use a structured multi-agent review and project contract. Coding work routes to the installed Karpathy and Superpowers skills.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $loong to analyze this task and state the assumptions, evidence, risks, and next action.
